decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9873. Series context: trend strength 0.9186 and seasonal strength 0.2476; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.111); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.967.
